prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Fast-track adoption flows and moving sign-in after pet adoption were helpful.
Photo quality callouts, interactive tip carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight layouts on the final welcome screen, background notification prompts, and account sync copy banners showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for initial flow changes and non-significant tests, but were too low for visual callouts, progress carousels, and path selection screens.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +10.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +9.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +7.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +7.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] First Interaction Playground Screen: Adds a hands-on playground screen right before final completion to let users practice dragging and interacting with their desktop pet. (why: Support mail shows users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails) and completion drops to 64.8% at finish.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Placement: Moves account sign-in to take place right after completing the pet adoption certificate. (why: Signing in early creates hesitation (78.3% sign_in conversion), and 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Readiness Diagnostic Flow: Introduces display and window overlay diagnostic checks on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets. (why: Waiting/home steps take a very long time (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app refusing to open.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Path Decision Speed Helper Callout: Adds a hint on the path selection screen reassuring users that they can alter their path anytime in app settings. (why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating severe long-tail hesitation.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Personality Micro-Activities During Wait: Adds an interactive tip carousel with pet care tips while the pet assets render in the background. (why: Home wait time is very high (mean 2336s) contributing to the low 25.5% overall onboarding completion rate.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Safeguard Copy: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly state that local pet data automatically attaches to the account without loss. (why: The top support theme with 8 emails concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
6: [home, notification] Adoption Completion Audio Bell Alert: Enables audio notifications and a audio chime component when pet rendering completes on the waiting screen. (why: High mean wait times (2336s on home, 5815s on finish) indicate users walk away while waiting for adoption completion.)

scores.note: Targets largest funnel drop (35.2% at finish) with support emails, but adding a new screen carries implementation friction.
Moving sign-in post-adoption aligns with proven lessons and directly addresses top support complaint (8 emails).
Addresses high wait times and desktop rendering issues, but complex flow additions saw muted historical gains.
Path selection callouts and hints perform very well, and simple hint callout is low cost (config/UI only).
Interactive tip carousels during wait times are proven effective (+7.8% historical lift on wait_info).
Config-only change with strong email evidence, but copy-only changes show weak historical conversion lift (+1.9%).
Notification prompts showed no clear effect in lessons, yielding modest gains (+3.4% historical).
